messages:
nina: FYI partner webhook accidentally persisted a Vault-wrapped blob to their logs bucket. partner claims they don't have unwrap rights but secbot saw multiple failed unwraps. need containment.

richard: can you share the object path and a redacted line?

nina: gs://partner-logs/2026-03-24/webhook/evt_5421.json
redacted: "payload="vault:v1:wrapped:eyJhbGc...""

secbot: alert: 12 failed transit/unwrap attempts for key=team-key between 09:10-09:18 UTC.

sam_platsec: immediate plan: pause ingest -> copy objects to quarantine -> rotate transit key -> revoke any ephemeral unwrap tokens -> temporary deny policy on transit/decrypt for partner SA.

kevin_ops: pausing ingest now. copying to gs://incident-quarantine/1767777001/.

olivia: I'll enumerate cross-wraps (GCP KMS <-> Vault). also enable Vault audit sink to internal SIEM and tag incident:1767777001.

richard: quick commands I'll run: `vault write -force transit/keys/team-key/rotate` and `vault token revoke -prefix partner-unwrap-`. will also apply a short-lived policy denying decrypt for partner SA.

sam_platsec: owners: nina (partner coord), richard (rotate + temp policy), olivia (cross-wrap audit), kevin_ops (quarantine). reconvene in 30m in #eng-security. :lock:
